name: evs
description: Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) is a service that you can use to deploy a VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) software environment directly on EC2 bare metal instances within an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

subcommands.name: associate-eip-to-vlan
subcommands.description: Associates an Elastic IP address with a public HCX VLAN.

subcommands.name: create-entitlement
subcommands.description: Creates a Windows Server License entitlement for virtual machines in an Amazon EVS environment using the provided vCenter Server connector.

subcommands.name: create-environment
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon EVS environment that runs VCF software, such as SDDC Manager, NSX Manager, and vCenter Server.

subcommands.name: create-environment-connector
subcommands.description: Creates a connector for an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: create-environment-host
subcommands.description: Creates an ESX host and adds it to an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: delete-entitlement
subcommands.description: Deletes a Windows Server License entitlement for virtual machines in an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: delete-environment
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: delete-environment-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes a connector from an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: delete-environment-host
subcommands.description: Deletes a host from an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: disassociate-eip-from-vlan
subcommands.description: Disassociates an Elastic IP address from a public HCX VLAN.

subcommands.name: get-depot-url
subcommands.description: Returns a URL and authentication token for accessing the Amazon EVS Custom Addon depot.

subcommands.name: get-environment
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the specified environment.

subcommands.name: get-versions
subcommands.description: Returns information about VCF versions, ESX versions and EC2 instance types provided by Amazon EVS.

subcommands.name: list-environment-connectors
subcommands.description: Lists the connectors within an environment.

subcommands.name: list-environment-hosts
subcommands.description: List the hosts within an environment.

subcommands.name: list-environment-vlans
subcommands.description: Lists environment VLANs that are associated with the specified environment.

subcommands.name: list-environments
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon EVS environments in your Amazon Web Services account in the specified Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for an Amazon EVS resource.

subcommands.name: list-vm-entitlements
subcommands.description: Lists the Windows Server License entitlements for virtual machines in an Amazon EVS environment.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to an Amazon EVS resource with the specified resourceArn.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from an Amazon EVS resource.

subcommands.name: update-environment-connector
subcommands.description: Updates a connector for an Amazon EVS environment.
